findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto_price, defi_rankings, defi_protocol, yield_pools, fees_revenue, funding_rates, hyperliquid_markets · Private data: chain_tvl, yield_pools · Public sink: dex_volumes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto_price, defi_rankings, defi_protocol, yield_pools, fees_revenue, funding_rates, hyperliquid_markets · Private data: chain_tvl, yield_pools · Public sink: dex_volumes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
